pitch_en: Environmental audits, impact studies, wastewater assessments, monitoring, and management plans helping Guatemalan companies stay compliant and competitive.

sections.head_en: Industrial operators face complex environmental rules, monitoring obligations, and reputational risk without in-house expertise.
sections.head_es: Los operadores industriales enfrentan normativa ambiental compleja, obligaciones de monitoreo y riesgo reputacional sin expertise interno.
sections.body_en: Companies need trusted consultants for EIA categories, wastewater studies, solid-waste plans, and ongoing environmental management.
sections.body_es: Las empresas necesitan consultores confiables para categorías de EIA, estudios de aguas residuales, planes de residuos sólidos y gestión ambiental continua.
